question.text: Under PIT 2015 Schedule C, the Compliance Officer shall report to:

answer.text: Board of directors or head(s) or Audit Committee Chairman

explanation.text: **The Logic:** CO reports to Board/heads/Audit Committee at defined frequency (at least annually). **The Trap:** Reporting only to SEBI bypasses internal governance. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same in III-A. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Schedule CO-board touchpoints on the annual calendar.
